title: Light, temperature, and substrate effects on the germination of three Bromus species in comparison with their abundance in the field
why: BGU record (opened; authors not shown): B. alopecuroides, B. fasciculatus and B. rubens seeds germinated faster in darkness below 20 C and faster in light at 20 C. A light/dark result for Bromus species; held for authors and DOI before it can be logged.
